newsitem.title: USA: Senate panel approves Herman nomination.
newsitem.headline: Senate panel approves Herman nomination.

text.p: The Senate Labour Committee Thursday unanimously approved the nomination of Alexis Herman as secretary of labour by voice vote and sent it to the full Senate for confirmation expected next week.
Herman was formerly head of the White House public liaison office and previously served in high posts at the Labour Department.
Senate Republican Leader Trent Lott told reporters he believed the Senate would act on the nomination next week.

Herman would replace Robert Reich as labour secretary. Her nomination had been held up while the committee looked into whether she played a role in White House and Democratic Party fund raising in the last election.

"Today's unanimous committee action is a solid bipartisan vote of confidence in Alexis Herman to be secretary of labour. Her background and experience make her extremely well qualified for this important responsibility," said Sen. Edward Kennedy, a Massachusetts Democrat.
